source='''def transform(grid):
    first = grid[0]
    period = next(p for p in range(1, len(first) + 1)
                  if all(v == 0 or v == first[i % p] for i, v in enumerate(first)))
    pattern = [first[i] if first[i] != 0 else next(
        first[j] for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1) if first[j] != 0
    ) for i in range(period)]
    return [[pattern[c % period] for c in range(len(row))] for row in grid]
'''
